entries.title: Esc on a maximized card keeps it maximized with Vim keys
entries.body: With the Vim, tmux or Emacs keys, Esc on a maximized card now always moves your keyboard to the card and leaves it maximized, so j and k go on scrolling it. Before, Esc from the card's buttons, its reply or right after maximizing gave the card its usual size back. Your Maximize or restore card key, such as Ctrl+W O, or Restore gives the size back.
entries.noPicture: Where the keyboard lands after a key press cannot show in a still picture; the card looks the same before and after.
